title: MAutoBroadcast
description: A high-performance, GUI-driven automated announcement system. Fully customizable intervals and messages with zero performance impact.
body:
⚡ Performance & Quality
Zero-Lag Architecture: Built with high-frequency servers in mind. The broadcasting engine runs with minimal resource usage.

In-Game Management: Add, edit, or remove broadcast messages directly via a Graphical User Interface (GUI).

Full Customization: Supports Hex Colors, MiniMessage, and multi-line announcements.

No Watermarks: Clean, professional output. Your server, your branding.

Configurable Intervals: Set exactly how often your messages should appear.

🛠 How it works
MAutoBroadcastV2 allows you to toggle specific messages on or off and change global intervals without ever leaving the game. All changes are saved instantly and synced with your config.yml.

📜 Commands

/autobroadcast (or /ab) – Opens the main management GUI.


🌐 Connect with Us
Professional tools for professional servers. Join our community for updates and premium support.
